title: Welcome
description: Unified attention dashboard — a desktop app that collects items that need your attention in one inbox, and keeps running in the background for syncs and notifications.

title: GitLab review requests
description: GitLab sync now also shows open merge requests where you are a reviewer, even without a matching label.

title: Sync fix
description: Fixed the inbox going empty and an "item already exists" error when a sync found nothing to change, e.g. after marking all items done.
